cast.speaker: Dexter
cast.description: Male voice in his late teens, American accent, nerdy and slightly nasal, dreamy and intense, speaks softly with a trembling reverent tone.

cast.speaker: Milo
cast.description: Male voice in his late teens, American accent, nerdy, awkward and increasingly panicked, higher pitched, nervous stammering delivery.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: Hey, remember when we played Catan with Bobby last Friday?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Hey, remember when we played Catan with Bobby last Friday?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: Yeah. He took the longest road and then trade-blocked me for forty minutes. Total tyrant.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Yeah. He took the longest road and then trade-blocked me for forty minutes. Total tyrant.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Don't you get a feeling... when you watch him play like that?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: Wha... what? What do you mean, a feeling? Like, indigestion?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Wha... what? What do you mean, a feeling? Like, indigestion?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... long road of his. <sigh> And the way he whispers, ore for wheat.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The way he moves the pieces... the way he builds. That long... long road of his.  And the way he whispers, ore for wheat.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: I... guess? He does have a really good... settlement placement?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I... guess? He does have a really good... settlement placement?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: <gasp> And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber? <whisper> I had to leave the room.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: And when he rolled a seven and moved the robber?  I had to leave the room.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Milo
dialogue_lines.text: <gulp> Dude. We were playing at your house.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Dude. We were playing at your house.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Dexter
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> So... you also find him sexy when he plays Catan?
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: So... you also find him sexy when he plays Catan?
